fc515.note: GLB PIPELINE TEST ONLY (flag kot401.glbtest, default OFF): stylised low-poly test rig, 2,724 tris, real-metre scale, tractor+trailer in one file. Loaded only when the glbtest flag is on; otherwise this entry is inert and the slot stays procedural. See SPEC.md in the staging folder.

nodeContract.detailNodes: Nodes whose name starts with Detail_ are hidden beyond 300 m (LOD tier 2); interior nodes named Interior_ beyond 170 m.
nodeContract.glassMaterial: Cab glass material named Glass — hidden automatically in the first-person cabin camera.
nodeContract.lightMaterials: Lamp materials named exactly LightHead, LightBrake, LightIndL, LightIndR, LightRev, LightMarker — the game drives their emissive intensity from real brake/indicator/reverse/marker state.
nodeContract.paintMaterial: Main cab paint material named Paint — the livery/company system recolours it.
nodeContract.wheels: Separate nodes named WheelFL, WheelFR (steer axle), WheelRL, WheelRR, WheelRL2, WheelRR2 (drive tandems), trailer: WheelTL, WheelTR, WheelTL2, WheelTR2. Pivot exactly at hub centre, no baked rotation; the game wraps them for steering (front pair) and spin (all).

note: King of the 401 realistic-model slots. NO models are installed yet: every slot falls back to the in-game procedural visuals, which were upgraded in the crafted-model rebuild (extruded cab/hood/sleeper profiles, per-model sleeper + trim variants, lathe-profiled wheels, ribbed dry-van sides, full trailer hardware) — still procedural, still no GLB. To install a model: copy its .glb into this folder and add an entry under "models" keyed by slot id, e.g. "fc515": { "file": "fc515.glb" }. Files must be self-contained GLB (embedded textures), glTF 2.0, no Draco/meshopt compression, metres, +Z forward, origin on the ground at the fifth-wheel datum (tractors) or the kingpin (trailer).

required.lod: LOD1 18000 tris, LOD2 6000 tris as separate GLBs fc515_lod1.glb / fc515_lod2.glb (optional)
required.vehicle: Freightliner Cascadia-style modern aero sleeper tractor (flagship)
Long-nose classic conventional sleeper tractor (e.g. 379/W900 style)
Modern standard conventional day-cab / short-sleeper tractor
Modern aero highway tractor (generic fleet aero)
AI hauler tractors — same three classes above, fleet paint variants

required.textureRes: 2048 side atlas (existing canvas wraps are drawn at 2048x384)
required.vehicle: 53 ft dry-van trailer with livery-artwork UV space on both sides and rear doors

sourcing: Commission or buy with a written licence covering redistribution inside a shipped game (e.g. a marketplace 'game distribution' licence), or CC0/CC-BY with the licence text + author credit stored beside the file. Proof needed per file: licence name, source URL, author, and the licence text or receipt kept in this folder as <slot>.LICENSE.txt. Do NOT use ripped game assets, Sketchfab downloads without a licence grant, or AI-converted models of unknown provenance.
